concerns.text: FR-010 states the system MUST ensure that no fabricated or placeholder values are used, but does not specify how this will be verified. Add an explicit verification method (e.g., provenance logs, checksum validation, or automated audit of all numeric fields) so the requirement is testable.

SC-001 requires statistical power ≥ 0.80 for detecting Cohen’s d ≥ 0.10, but the procedure for estimating power is not defined. Specify the power analysis method (e.g., simulation parameters, number of replicates, software used) to make the criterion measurable.
